name: Syllabic Script Encoding
mechanism: Represent recurring spoken syllabic units with agreed written signs
operating_requirement: A usable sign inventory, writing medium and trained readers
consequence: Encode speech through a syllabic convention without requiring an alphabet

name: Consonantal Script Encoding
mechanism: Represent a language primarily through agreed consonantal signs with context or auxiliary marks
operating_requirement: A suitable language convention, medium and trained readers
consequence: Support a consonantal writing route with its own ambiguity and teaching needs

name: Alphabetic Script Encoding
mechanism: Represent consonantal and vocalic distinctions through an agreed segmental sign system
operating_requirement: Maintained sign-sound conventions and literacy instruction
consequence: Support alphabetic recording without claiming universal superiority over other scripts

name: Written Word-Boundary Conventions
mechanism: Mark or infer conventional boundaries among written units under an agreed reading practice
operating_requirement: A shared orthographic convention, actual texts and readers
consequence: Reduce specified parsing ambiguity without imposing spaces on every script

name: Punctuation Scope Conventions
mechanism: Use agreed marks or layout to signal grouping, pause and scope in written expression
operating_requirement: Maintained conventions and interpretable text production
consequence: Express selected structure without eliminating linguistic ambiguity

name: Stable Document Locators
mechanism: Assign references that locate passages consistently within a declared document version
operating_requirement: Ordered records, maintained version identity and locator conventions
consequence: Support precise citation while retaining edition and reordering differences

name: Controlled Subject Vocabularies
mechanism: Maintain agreed subject terms and relationships for consistent record description
operating_requirement: Curators, usable terminology and revision records
consequence: Improve cross-record retrieval without enforcing one universal conceptual scheme

name: Archival Appraisal Methods
mechanism: Assess records for evidentiary and anticipated use value against declared retention constraints
operating_requirement: Actual records, accountable reviewers and documented appraisal criteria
consequence: Choose preservation priorities without declaring discarded history unimportant

name: Record Retention Schedules
mechanism: Assign review, retention and authorized disposition conditions to defined record classes
operating_requirement: Recognized authority, inventories and preservation or disposal capacity
consequence: Manage finite archives without automatic deletion merely because a method is learned

name: Optical Character Recognition
mechanism: Infer encoded text from measured images of written or printed characters
operating_requirement: Actual image capture, qualified character models and correction capacity
consequence: Produce a provisional transcription with retained recognition errors

name: Script Transliteration Rules
mechanism: Map a declared writing convention into another with recorded distinctions and losses
operating_requirement: Defined source and target conventions, competent reviewers and examples
consequence: Aid cross-script access without claiming translation or reversible mapping in every case

name: Character Normalization Rules
mechanism: Transform encoded sequences according to declared equivalence rules while preserving required distinctions
operating_requirement: A versioned equivalence specification and conforming implementations
consequence: Compare qualified equivalent text without equating visually similar characters automatically

name: Multilingual Collation Rules
mechanism: Order encoded strings using declared language-sensitive comparison levels and tailoring
operating_requirement: Maintained comparison rules and compatible implementations
consequence: Sort records reproducibly while preserving language and version differences

name: Tactile Character Codes
mechanism: Encode readable symbols as a qualified tactile pattern system
operating_requirement: Agreed code, suitable dimensions and reader instruction
consequence: Provide nonvisual text access without assuming all raised marks are equally readable

name: Tactile Record Embossing
mechanism: Form durable qualified tactile patterns in a suitable medium
operating_requirement: Actual embossing tools, compatible material and legibility checks
consequence: Produce readable tactile records while retaining wear and material costs

name: Magnetic Tape Data Recording
mechanism: Encode and recover digital blocks on a moving magnetic medium with timing and integrity controls
operating_requirement: Actual tape, heads, drive, encoding electronics and maintained alignment
consequence: Store bounded digital records with sequential-access and degradation costs

name: Optical Disc Recording
mechanism: Encode and recover data through qualified optical changes along a tracked rotating medium
operating_requirement: Compatible medium, optics, servo control and encoding equipment
consequence: Store finite data with format and media-lifetime limits

name: Lossless Data Compression
mechanism: Represent data with fewer symbols under a reversible coding scheme when its structure permits
operating_requirement: Compatible encoder and decoder, actual computation and retained format knowledge
consequence: Reduce some storage or traffic without reducing every possible input

name: Lossy Media Coding
mechanism: Discard or approximate declared signal information against an evaluated distortion criterion
operating_requirement: Qualified encoder, decoder and explicit quality targets
consequence: Reduce media traffic at an irreversible information-loss cost

name: Frequency-Division Multiplexing
mechanism: Carry separate signals in allocated frequency bands with qualified filtering
operating_requirement: Actual band capacity, compatible filters and transmit-receive equipment
consequence: Share a link while retaining guard-band and interference limits

name: Time-Division Multiplexing
mechanism: Share a transmission path through declared time slots and synchronization
operating_requirement: Compatible timing, switching and finite slot capacity
consequence: Carry several streams without multiplying total path capacity

name: Wavelength-Division Multiplexing
mechanism: Carry separable optical channels at qualified wavelengths in one physical fiber
operating_requirement: Compatible sources, wavelength-selective elements and verified channel margins
consequence: Increase supported aggregate traffic while retaining power and crosstalk limits

name: Phase-Shift Keying
mechanism: Encode digital symbols through qualified carrier phase states
operating_requirement: Stable reference, compatible modulation and detection and measured channel conditions
consequence: Provide a digital signaling route with noise and synchronization limits

name: Quadrature Amplitude Modulation
mechanism: Encode symbols through qualified combinations of two quadrature signal components
operating_requirement: Linear signal chain, compatible constellation decoding and adequate signal quality
consequence: Trade symbol density against required channel quality

name: Orthogonal Multicarrier Modulation
mechanism: Distribute symbols over coordinated orthogonal subcarriers with qualified timing and channel handling
operating_requirement: Actual processing, synchronization and suitable transmission hardware
consequence: Support a multicarrier link while retaining overhead and channel sensitivity

name: Direct-Sequence Spreading
mechanism: Spread a signal with a declared code and recover it through matched correlation
operating_requirement: Compatible spreading code, timing and receiver processing
consequence: Trade occupied bandwidth for a qualified interference response without secrecy guarantees

name: Frequency-Hopping Links
mechanism: Move a compatible link across a synchronized sequence of frequencies
operating_requirement: Tunable terminals, timing and usable spectrum
consequence: Provide a hopping signaling path with coordination and interference constraints

name: Adaptive Channel Equalization
mechanism: Estimate and compensate a qualified transmission channel's distortion from observations
operating_requirement: Actual training or decision evidence, processing and stable adaptation limits
consequence: Recover symbols under specified distortion without correcting arbitrary loss

name: Carrier and Timing Recovery
mechanism: Estimate carrier and symbol timing references from a received signal
operating_requirement: Qualified receiver, sufficient signal structure and loop stability
consequence: Synchronize reception within an acquisition and tracking envelope

name: Antenna Array Beamforming
mechanism: Control relative signals across antenna elements to shape a qualified directional response
operating_requirement: Actual array, phase or delay control and calibration
consequence: Steer or shape coverage while retaining aperture, sidelobe and power limits

name: Spatial-Stream Multiplexing
mechanism: Separate simultaneous streams through measured spatial channel structure
operating_requirement: Multiple qualified signal paths, channel estimation and suitable propagation
consequence: Increase supported streams only when channel conditions provide separable information

name: Cellular Frequency Reuse
mechanism: Plan separated service areas that reuse spectrum within interference limits
operating_requirement: Actual sites, assessed propagation and coordinated frequencies
consequence: Expand regional service without making neighboring cells interference-free

name: Mobile Link Handover
mechanism: Transfer a moving terminal's service between qualified access sites with bounded interruption
operating_requirement: Observed coverage, compatible control signaling and available destination capacity
consequence: Maintain some sessions during movement while retaining handover failure and outage

name: Spectrum Occupancy Sensing
mechanism: Measure time-varying signal occupancy over a declared frequency range
operating_requirement: Calibrated receiver, observation time and detection limits
consequence: Inform access decisions without proving an undetected user is absent

name: Underwater Acoustic Communication
mechanism: Encode and recover information through a qualified underwater sound channel
operating_requirement: Actual transducers, power and measured propagation and noise
consequence: Provide slow bounded submerged communication without radio-like latency or bandwidth

name: Optical Amplifier Link Design
mechanism: Integrate optical gain while accounting for added noise, saturation and spectral effects
operating_requirement: Actual compatible amplifier, pumping power and verified link margins
consequence: Extend a supported optical span without restoring lost information perfectly

name: Coherent Optical Reception
mechanism: Combine received light with a qualified local optical reference to recover encoded field information
operating_requirement: Compatible optics, reference source, detectors and processing
consequence: Recover supported optical modulation with phase and noise constraints

name: Optical Dispersion Compensation
mechanism: Measure and compensate pulse or phase spreading in a qualified optical link
operating_requirement: Characterized fiber, compatible compensation hardware or processing
consequence: Preserve usable signaling over a specified span without eliminating all nonlinear effects

name: Adaptive Link-Rate Selection
mechanism: Choose among qualified signaling rates using measured channel and loss conditions
operating_requirement: Compatible rate options, feedback and actual link observations
consequence: Trade throughput and delivery reliability without assuming the fastest rate always works

name: Distance-Vector Routing
mechanism: Exchange neighbor reachability estimates and choose routes using a declared metric
operating_requirement: Operating routers, actual neighbor links and bounded update handling
consequence: Build routes from local exchanges while retaining convergence and loop risks

name: Link-State Routing
mechanism: Distribute observed link descriptions and calculate routes from a maintained topology view
operating_requirement: Actual routers, control traffic, computation and stale-state handling
consequence: Choose routes from a shared view without assuming instantaneous agreement

name: Path-Vector Routing
mechanism: Advertise reachability with path information and apply declared inter-network policy
operating_requirement: Actual participating networks, usable paths and maintained policy
consequence: Route across independently administered networks while retaining policy conflicts and misinformation risk

name: Multicast Distribution Trees
mechanism: Replicate traffic along maintained distribution branches for an identified receiver group
operating_requirement: Actual group membership, router support and branch capacity
consequence: Reduce duplicated shared-path traffic without free delivery to absent receivers

name: Packet Priority Scheduling
mechanism: Select queued packets under an explicit service discipline and starvation limits
operating_requirement: Actual queues, available output capacity and declared priorities
consequence: Change delay distribution without creating bandwidth

name: Network Admission Control
mechanism: Admit a requested service only against declared and observed resource commitments
operating_requirement: Actual capacity records, enforceable admission decisions and current reservations
consequence: Limit overcommitment while retaining estimation error and rejected requests

name: Packet Address Hierarchy
mechanism: Allocate and aggregate destination identifiers according to a declared routing hierarchy
operating_requirement: Maintained address authority and compatible routing tables
consequence: Reduce some routing state without eliminating renumbering or topology changes

name: Maximum Packet-Path Discovery
mechanism: Determine a qualified transmission size that can traverse a changing path
operating_requirement: Actual feedback or observations and compatible endpoint behavior
consequence: Avoid some oversized transmissions while retaining stale or blocked feedback

name: Transport Loss-Recovery Timing
mechanism: Estimate retransmission timing from observed delays and uncertainty
operating_requirement: Actual acknowledgments, timing observations and bounded backoff rules
consequence: Reduce needless retransmission without distinguishing every delay from loss

name: Explicit Congestion Feedback
mechanism: Signal congestion before or alongside loss using compatible network and endpoint behavior
operating_requirement: Actual supporting routers, readable feedback and responsive senders
consequence: Improve some load responses without guaranteeing cooperation or spare capacity

name: Network Measurement Probes
mechanism: Infer selected path behavior from controlled observations with probe effects accounted for
operating_requirement: Actual endpoints, timestamps and bounded measurement traffic
consequence: Estimate latency or loss without revealing all internal network state

name: Software-Defined Forwarding
mechanism: Separate an authorized control decision process from rule execution in forwarding devices
operating_requirement: Actual controller, compatible devices and maintained rules
consequence: Reconfigure supported paths while retaining controller and rule-distribution failures

name: Network Configuration Transactions
mechanism: Stage and validate coordinated rule changes with explicit partial-failure behavior
operating_requirement: Actual devices, verified configuration state and rollback resources
consequence: Reduce inconsistent updates without assuming a whole network changes atomically

name: Anycast Service Routing
mechanism: Advertise a shared service destination from multiple qualified sites using routing policy
operating_requirement: Actual service replicas, routes and consistent service behavior
consequence: Reach a selected available site without guaranteeing the geographically nearest or session continuity

name: Content Delivery Caches
mechanism: Serve qualified retained content near demand while managing freshness and misses
operating_requirement: Actual cache storage, reachable origin and valid reuse rules
consequence: Reduce repeated transfer while retaining stale-data and cache-fill costs

name: Intermittent Contact Scheduling
mechanism: Plan storage and transmission against known or uncertain future contact opportunities
operating_requirement: Actual contact evidence, buffers, power and link capacity
consequence: Deliver some delayed data without treating scheduled contact as completed transfer

name: Contact-Graph Route Planning
mechanism: Route bundles through time-bounded future contacts with capacity and expiry constraints
operating_requirement: Qualified schedules, finite storage and updated route computation
consequence: Use planned intermittent paths while retaining missed-contact uncertainty

name: Network Fault-Domain Design
mechanism: Partition service dependencies so a defined failure need not disable every path
operating_requirement: Actual physically and administratively assessed dependencies and maintained alternatives
consequence: Reduce correlated outage exposure without assuming nominally distinct providers are independent

name: Semantic Message-Schema Evolution
mechanism: Evolve message structure through declared compatibility and interpretation rules
operating_requirement: Versioned schemas, capable endpoints and checked migration examples
consequence: Retain selected interoperability without silently reinterpreting old records

name: Evidence Transfer Acceptance
mechanism: Verify that a delivered evidence package is complete and interpretable for its declared question
operating_requirement: Actual received records, maintained metadata and local review capacity
consequence: Separate physical receipt from usable research evidence and local mastery
